rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a diamond gemstone.

example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 zyun3 sek6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sim2

rows.note: Use this for the diamond or rhombus shape, rather than for the gemstone.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 biu1 zi3 hai6 ling4 jing4

rows.note: Use this as the Cantonese name for a card in the diamonds suit.

example.english: The card in my hand is a diamond.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau2 soeng6 go2 zoeng1 hai6 gaai1 zyun1

rows.note: Use this more technical term for the carbon mineral itself rather than a gemstone.

example.english: Diamond is one of the hardest minerals in nature.
example.traditional: 金剛石係自然界最硬嘅礦物之一。
example.jyutping: gam1 gong1 sek6 hai6 zi6 jin4 gaai3 zeoi3 ngaang6 ge3 kwong3 mat6 zi1 jat1
